mapper.select: SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.code = 'default' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_permission perm WHERE perm.is_deleted = 0 ) ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_tenant_package_permission tpp WHERE tpp.package_id = p.id AND tpp.is_deleted = 0 ) END AS permission_count FROM sys_tenant_package p ${ew.customSqlSegment}
